The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) issues the Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) as the broad baseline, the Critical Systems Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC) for critical national systems, and the Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC) for cloud. The PDPL is the personal-data privacy law, overseen by SDAIA, and applies to anyone handling Saudi residents' personal data. The SAMA Cyber Security Framework applies to financial institutions regulated by the Saudi Central Bank.
